news.title: Logan Cooley completes hat trick with second left, Mammoth stun Penguins in OT
news.ruTitle: Логан Кули оформил хет-трик вторым слева, Мамонт оглушил «Пингвинз» в овертайме
news.description: Logan Cooley, a Pittsburgh native, completed a hat trick against his hometown team with a second left, Mikhail Sergachev scored at 3:27 of overtime, and the Mammoth stunned the Penguins 4-3 on Thursday night.

news.title: Cole Hutson scores twice as the Capitals beat the Predators 4-3
news.ruTitle: Коул Хатсон забивает дважды, когда «Кэпиталз» обыграли «Хищников» со счетом 4–3.
news.description: — Cole Hutson scored twice to lead the Washington Capitals to a 4-3 victory over the Nashville Predators on Thursday night.

news.title: Schaefer scores his 2nd goal of the game in OT to lift Islanders past Wild, 4-3
news.ruTitle: Шефер забивает свой второй гол в матче в овертайме и помог «Айлендерс» обыграть «Уайлд» со счетом 4–3.
news.description: — Matthew Schaefer scored his second goal of the game on a wrist shot at 33 seconds of overtime to give the New York Islanders a 4-3 victory over the Minnesota Wild on Thursday night.

news.title: Thomas, Broberg lead Blues to 4-1 win over Bruins
news.ruTitle: Томас и Броберг привели "Блюз" к победе над "Брюинз" со счетом 4:1
news.description: — Robert Thomas and Philip Broberg each had a goal and two assists to lead the St. Louis Blues to a 4-1 win over the Boston Bruins on Thursday night.

news.title: Caufield, Newhook each score twice in Canadiens' 5-2 win over Stars
news.ruTitle: Кофилд и Ньюхук забили по два гола в победе «Канадиенс» над «Старз» со счетом 5:2.
news.description: — Cole Caufield and Alex Newhook scored two goals each as the Montreal Canadiens beat the Dallas Stars 5-2 on Thursday night.

news.description: — Logan Cooley completed a hat trick against his hometown team with a second left, Mikhail Sergachev scored at 3:27 of overtime and the Utah Mammoth stunned the Pittsburgh Penguins 4-3 on Thursday night.

news.title: Holmberg has a career-high 4 points as the Lightning beat the Jets 6-4 to remain unbeaten at home

news.description: — Pontus Holmberg set a career high with four points on a goal and three assists, Brandon Hagel and Anthony Cirelli each had a goal and two assists, and the Tampa Bay Lightning remain unbeaten at home with a 6-4 victory over the Winnipeg Jets on...

news.title: Jankowski, Kochetkov lead Hurricanes to 3-2 win over Blue Jackets
news.ruTitle: Янковский и Кочетков привели «Харрикейнз» к победе над «Блю Джекетс» со счетом 3:2.
news.description: — Mark Jankowski scored in the third period for a three-goal lead, Pyotr Kochetkov made 24 saves and the Carolina Hurricanes beat the Columbus Blue Jackets 3-2 on Thursday night.

news.title: Kendall Coyne Schofield taking PWHL season off after announcing pregnancy
news.ruTitle: Кендалл Койн Шофилд берет перерыв в сезоне PWHL после объявления о беременности
news.description: Four-time U.S. Olympian and Minnesota Frost captain Kendall Coyne Schofield is taking a leave from hockey because she is pregnant with her second child, she announced Thursday.

news.title: Red Wings suspend star forward Dylan Larkin as team explores trade options
news.ruTitle: Red Wings отстранили звездного нападающего Дилана Ларкина, поскольку команда изучает варианты обмена
news.description: The Red Wings announced Thursday that star forward Dylan Larkin has been suspended without pay after informing the team he no longer wanted to play for Detroit.

news.title: Stack your fantasy hockey lineups with Sharks, Rangers in November
